examples.arabic: كان شكل حياته مختلف خالص عن ايامنا زمان هو بيكلم اولاده عن ألعاب جديدة
examples.english: His life looked completely different from our days back then; he was talking to his children about new games.
examples.transliteration: Kan shakl hayato mokhtalef khales 'an ayyamna zaman howwa beykallem awlado 'an al'ab gedeeda.

examples.arabic: الاحتفال كان مختلف لكل جيل لكن كله كان فرحان مع بعض
examples.english: The celebration was different for each generation, but everyone was happy together.
examples.transliteration: El ehtefal kan mokhtalef le koll geel laken kollu kan farhan ma'a ba'd.

examples.arabic: بس صوته كان مختلف انا مش فاهم
examples.english: But his voice was different, I don't understand.
examples.transliteration: Bas soto kan mokhtalef ana mesh fahem.

examples.arabic: بعد ساعة الطبخة كانت جاهزة بس شكلها كان مختلف شوية
examples.english: After an hour, the dish was ready, but its appearance was a bit different.
examples.transliteration: Ba'd sa'a el-tabkha kanet gahza bas shaklaha kan mokhtalef shwayya.

examples.arabic: هناك شفت صاحبي القديم عم حسن كان شكله مختلف اوي
examples.english: There, I saw my old friend, Uncle Hassan, he looked very different.
examples.transliteration: Henak shoft sahby el adeem Amm Hassan kan shaklo mokhtalef awy

examples.arabic: لما دقتها حسيت بطعم مختلف بس حلو اوي
examples.english: When I tasted it, I felt a different but very delicious taste.
examples.transliteration: Lamma do'toha hasset be ta3m mokhtalef bas helw awi.
